title: Saving a ticket layout replaces its Detail view with the Create view (Standard layout cannot be saved)
env: staging-desk.taviportal.com (NDC-Staging) · Setup › Modules & Fields › Tickets › Layouts › Standard · Edge 156, Windows 10

panels.caption: Standard layout, Detail View tab: Resolution is on the Detail view (1). It is not on the Create tab.
Jam 0:09: one label change on the Create tab (2), then Save, gives "Layout not saved: resolution cannot be removed" (3).
(4) Left: Detail view as stored. Right: Detail view the editor sends on Save. It is a copy of the Create view, so Resolution and the whole Integration section (CRM deal, contract) are dropped.

rows: Detail view of the Standard layout
